shortDescription: By Echo WangAnthropic’s IPO raised $81.31 billion on Wednesday, eclipsing SpaceX’s offering to claim the title of the largest stock-market debut on record, one person familiar with the matter said.The IPO was priced at $83 apiece, above its indicated price.
